search_text: published ZDI-19-583 ZDI-CAN-6995 (0Day) Alibaba Alipay URL Scheme Handling Vulnerability 2019-06-27 4.5 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ['Alibaba'] ['Alipay'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to modify requests on affected installations of Alibaba Alipay. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of URL schemes. The issue resides in the improper validation if a URL Scheme was acted upon by a malicious application. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to steal tokens and manipulate requests in the context of current user.
